The '''Sword of the First''' was a dueling blade wielded by the [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan's founder|founder]] of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (dueling blade)|clan]]. He came upon a large beast and buried the sword in her skull, but the creature survived the injury and ate him. The clan eventually sought to reclaim the sword.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Sword of the First}}</ref>
